messages:
deploy-bot: PROD: manual approval requested for release `v3.12.0` (commit `abcdef12`) to production in change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary finished: 500 users, 6m run, error rate 0.3% -> within threshold. Metrics: p50=85ms, p95=210ms, p99=420ms. Rolling strategy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10min pause checks.

emma: quick question — any DB migrations or schema flags in this release?

sam: no DB schema changes. Only runtime config + quantization profile swap for the `embedder-8b` model (int8) and a tiny routing policy tweak.

ravi: can you confirm the model pinning? we should pin prod runtimes to `embedder-8b@2026-03-18-09` and keep `embedder-8b@2026-02-20` as immediate fallback.

sam: confirmed. rollout will pin the new variant at deploy time. fallback command is: `redwood rollout revert --service inference --tag embedder-8b@2026-02-20` (estimated revert time 3m).

kirsten: ops checklist: pre-checks done (staging smoke OK, load test sampled 10k qps scaled down). Health probes green. Canary observers: no hallucination regressions on eval set A. Will monitor latency budget and token cost.

ops-oncall: note — we have a manual holdpoint at 23:20 UTC for final go/no-go. If anything looks off we abort and run revert. RTO target 5m, RPO nil (no DB changes).

emma: are there any config flags to flip post-deploy? I want to know if we need a quick client-side toggle.

sam: just `ENABLE_NEW_EMBEDDER=true` on router config for the canary hosts; we'll stage config flip in two batches.

ravi: approving for prod gate. :thumbsup: I understand rollback plan and pinning.

kirsten: approving as SRE. will be on-call during the window. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Approved by `ravi`, `kirsten`. Proceeding to rollout at schedule (23:00 UTC). Recording approvers in audit log.

emma: leaving a note — add a short blurb to the release notes: "Switch embedder to int8 quantized variant; reduces inference cost ~28% with parity on eval sets."

sam: noted, will add to release notes and post-update channel summary.

ops-oncall: reminder — if we trigger revert, runbook step 2 is to run `redwood infra scale --service inference --to 0 --region us-east-1` before reverting to avoid malformed cache states.

deploy-bot: Rollout started at 23:00:12 UTC. Canary group (10%) in prod. Live metrics: p95=220ms, errors=0.35% (within alert threshold).

sam: canary looks stable at +6m. proceeding to 50%

kirsten: monitoring dashboards look nominal. No increase in downstream queueing.

deploy-bot: Rollout reached 50% at 23:12:04 UTC. Pausing for 10m checks.

ops-oncall: FYI — one alert fired in staging earlier about a memory spike on harness nodes, it was an unrelated test. already investigated.

ravi: thanks. standing by for final 100% push.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 23:25:41 UTC. Post-deploy health checks PASSED. Audit id: `audit-20260320-1987654321`.

emma: great work team. leaving note to track cost delta in next 24h.

sam: will monitor and open an eval if we see any quality drift.

kirsten: closing thread and marking as deployed. :party_popper:
